column4: responsible=The AI Safety Institute; for_what=Ensuring an evidence-based, proportionate UK response to regulating AI risks

column4: responsible=Key regulators; for_what=Publishing updates on their strategic approach to AI

column4: responsible=A new steering committee; for_what=Supporting and guiding a formal regulator coordination structure
column5: Establishing a steering committee to support and guide the activities of a formal regulator coordination structure within government in the spring.

column4: responsible=Central government departments; for_what=Mandatory use of the Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard
column5: Phasing in the mandatory requirement for central government departments to use the Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard (ATRS) over the course of the year.

column4: responsible=Republic of Korea (co-host with UK) and France; for_what=Hosting the next AI Safety Summits

column4: safeguard=Mandatory Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard (ATRS) for central government; binding=obligation

column4: safeguard=AI Management Essentials minimum good practice standard; binding=recommendation

column4: safeguard=Potential Code of Practice for cyber security of AI; binding=unclear

column4: safeguard=Guidance on AI use in HR and recruitment; binding=recommendation

column4: safeguard=State-led testing of frontier AI systems; binding=commitment

column4: safeguard=AI Safety Institute international safety testing partnerships; binding=commitment

column4: safeguard=Central AI risk assessment informed by AI Safety Institute; binding=commitment

column4: safeguard=Cross-economy AI risk register; binding=commitment

column4: safeguard=£10 million regulator capability programme; binding=commitment

column4: safeguard=Regulator coordination steering committee; binding=commitment

column4: safeguard=Corporate governance requirements for developers (under consideration); binding=unclear

column4: safeguard=International dialogue on electoral interference risks; binding=commitment

column4: safeguard=Call for evidence on deepfakes and trust in information; binding=commitment

column4: safeguard=Transparency mechanisms for rights holders (exploratory); binding=unclear
